mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing nortriptyline metabolism and increasing tricyclic antidepressant plasma concentrations, which may enhance anticholinergic and cardiac effects.
action: Monitor for increased nortriptyline toxicity (dry mouth, urinary retention, orthostatic hypotension, arrhythmias); consider nortriptyline dose reduction or alternative antibiotic if signs emerge.
